Ajuda.capa: This issue's number and date, and who signs as editor.
Ajuda.manchete: The main story: it appears at the top of the first page, with big letters and the main image.
Ajuda.noticia: The first two appear next to the headline; the next ones go to "Other news" and to the following pages.
Ajuda.rumor: Short rumors going around. One or two sentences are enough.

Ajuda.final: Footer printed at the end of the newspaper and a note only for you.

Vazio.aviso: No notices yet. E.g.: "50 gp reward for catching the Raven."
Vazio.classificado: No ads yet. E.g.: "The Safe Harbor tavern: clean rooms."
